additions.name: Switch AMS2, Woerden colocation

status.summary: In its October 14 portfolio, Switch listed AMS2 at Polanerbaan 1 in Woerden as an expanded colocation data centre.

locator.precision: Official civic address point of the named commercial property.
locator.identity_review: The facility sources identify Polanerbaan 1, Woerden. BAG ties that address to a single registered unit and building.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The national register positions the civic address and does not quantify its offset from individual colocation space.

additions.distinctness_review: The property is in Woerden and differs from Switch AMS3 in Amsterdam and AMS4 in Diemen. The RVO return NL-Switch2 names the same operator, facility code and municipality. The nearest previously mapped property is PowerGrow greenhouse, De Kwakel, 18.22 km away.
additions.site_identity_review: The property is in Woerden and differs from Switch AMS3 in Amsterdam and AMS4 in Diemen. The RVO return NL-Switch2 names the same operator, facility code and municipality. The nearest previously mapped property is PowerGrow greenhouse, De Kwakel, 18.22 km away.
additions.successor_review: The November sale and leaseback retained Switch as the facility operator. The commercial rent-back is distinct from completion of planned upgrades.

additions.name: Previder PDC1, existing colocation operations in Hengelo

status.summary: On November 4 Previder confirmed completion of work on the customer service linking its two Hengelo data centres, including Previder PDC1.

locator.method: Published BAG address point in OGC:CRS84.
locator.precision: Official address point for Expolaan 50, 7556BE Hengelo.
locator.identity_review: Page 3 of Previder’s facility matrix lists Previder PDC1 at Expolaan 50. Its colocation service page confirms the address. The official BAG address and postcode match.
locator.uncertainty_reason: BAG gives no numerical positional accuracy for this address point.

additions.distinctness_review: Previder PDC1 has a separate address and BAG object from its Hengelo sibling. The closest existing Atlas property is Equinix EN1, Auke Vleerstraat 1, Enschede at 7.8 km.
additions.successor_review: The November 4 operator completion update confirms service between its two Hengelo facilities. The 2025 energy return is used for the earlier measurement period.
